resources.string: Bricohams Radio Workspace HTTPS host. Tokens stay in client memory. No local USB access. Leaving closes the client; reconnect explicitly. PTT and audio require local configuration and RF acceptance.
Loading the HTTPS host; sign in within the client.
HTTPS client loaded; sign in and check agent status.
Microphone permission denied. No audio preparation or transmission starts.
Remote client closed. Check radio RX if transmitting; the watchdog does not replace a physical stop.
URL not permitted. Use HTTPS without credentials, paths, query or fragments; navigation to another origin is blocked.
TLS certificate rejected. Validation is not bypassed.
Could not load the host. Check URL, certificate and network.
Permission processed. Reconnect and explicitly prepare the microphone; it never starts automatically.
